newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Market quiet, supplies tight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Market quiet, supplies tight.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were mostly unchanged Friday with most dealers reporting moderate interest for promptly shipped supplies but little interest for deferred material, dealers said.
"The buying psychology is to stay close, unless this thing (market) breaks," a Buffalo dealer said.
Recent strong gains in Chicago Board of Trade corn and soymeal prices has discouraged millfeed sellers from cutting prices, but it also has discouraged buyers from enlarging inventories.
Millfeed supplies for prompt shipment remain tight, the product of reduced flour production, dealers said.

Although flour exports remain slow, one dealer said the start of baseball season prompts a slight increase in flour production. Flour is needed to make the hot dog buns consumed in ball parks, he said.
